name.ja: Figure-rise Standard　超サイヤ人ブロリーフルパワー
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan Broly Full Power

ja: 映画『ドラゴンボール超 ブロリー』より、最強のサイヤ人ブロリーを立体化！
• 特徴的な腰巻や衣装を新規造形で再現。
• 躍動感のある筋肉の造形により、強靭な肉体を表現。
• 差し替え式の表情パーツと手首パーツにより力強いポーズを再現可能。
• 特徴的な傷跡は曲面への追従性が高いマーキングシールで再現！
• 表情パーツは「叫び」と「怒り」の２種付属。
• 悟空とベジータ用のダメージ顔が付属。
en: From the movie "Dragon Ball Super: Broly", the strongest Saiyan Broly is now in 3D!
• The characteristic loincloth and costume are reproduced with new modeling.
• Expresses a strong body with dynamic muscle modeling.
• Powerful poses can be recreated with interchangeable expression parts and wrist parts.
• Characteristic scars are reproduced with MarkingSeal, which has high followability to curved surfaces!
• Two types of facial expression parts are included: "screaming " and " angry".
• Damaged faces for Goku and Vegeta are included.

ja: 表情パーツ2種（怒り、叫び）×各1
手首パーツ2種（左右握り手、左右平手）×各1
超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人孫悟空、ベジータ用ダメージ顔×各1
en: 2 types of facial expression parts (anger, scream) x 1 each
2 types of wrist parts (left and right grip hands, left and right palm) x 1 each
Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Son Goku, damage face for Vegeta x 1 each
